lastCompletedStory.title: Docs: recovery-runbook credential + DNS-firewall section and ADR for the containerized substrate + credential model

nextStoryContext: All 6 stories in the PRD are now passes:true. The PRD is complete. US-006 extended docs/recovery-runbook.md section (x) with a credential-provisioning subsection (GITHUB_TOKEN fine-grained PAT + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN via claude setup-token, both injected via containerEnv) and a dnsmasq DNS-firewall explanation. The ADR (0003) was extended with the credential model (HTTPS token, no SSH) and an explicit inert-substrate note referencing CAM-152 (B-2) as the story that will flip the fail-closed dispatch. The 7-domain table was updated from raw.githubusercontent.com to objects.githubusercontent.com (the correct Git LFS host per US-004 intent). The next action is /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: dnsmasq --ipset confirmed: places resolved IP addresses into the named Netfilter ipset on every DNS answer, dynamically. Domain matching covers subdomains. ipset must exist before dnsmasq starts (script does ipset create before dnsmasq invocation). Implementation is correct.
